title: Hearty Malaysian Chicken Noodles
description: A malty and light Malaysian dish featuring poppy seeds and nimono-simmer, high in protein and perfect for adventure seekers
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until lightly browned
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through
In a large pot, bring water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and coconut milk
Add the soy sauce mixture to the pan with the chicken and stir to combine
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce
Sprinkle the poppy seeds over the top of the noodles and serve hot
